tools.name: find_tools_for_task
tools.description: Ranks the products AgentDrives has test-driven for a task given in plain words (e.g. 'send an invoice'). Each result: the agent level (0-5: 0 Read-only, 1 Needs a person, 2 Gets in, 3 Does the work, 4 Runs on its own, 5 Autonomous); gets_in_alone (our agent signed up and got a key without a person);

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Searches AgentDrives' tested products by name, domain or what they do. Filters: category, minimum agent level (0-5: 0 Read-only, 1 Needs a person, 2 Gets in, 3 Does the work, 4 Runs on its own, 5 Autonomous), how an agent gets in (access: pay per call, no key, a key by API, its own sign-up…), agent-

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Returns any product we drove (once the directory opens, with directory.state: audited, in_audit; none: its basic record): its full test-drive result (13 to 35 KB, usually about 19 KB; brief: true gives the headline in 2.5 to 5 KB, usually about 3 KB): how far an agent gets with it and where it stops

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every category in the directory: its id (for search_tools' category filter), its name, the number of products listed in it and the best agent level in it (0-5); once the directory opens, how many are Audited and In Audit (directory, with note: why they are listed).

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: What changed in the directory in the last days (default 7, at most 31): level_moves, each product's level going up or down between two of its drives, with the date, the cause in words (our agent changed, not confirmed by a second drive yet, sign-up varies from drive to drive) and the level listed no

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_tools_for_task, search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: find_tools_for_task · Destructive: get_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_tools_for_task, search_tools, get_tool · Private data: get_tool · Public sink: find_tools_for_task · Destructive: get_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
